risks.title: Concurrence accrue en thérapies cellulaires
risks.score_rationale: The company faces ongoing competitive headwinds in cell therapy products (Tecartus, Yescarta), with expected sales decreases in 2026 due to competitive pressures Citation: "The volume of drug pricing-related legislation and administrative action has dramatically increased in recent years". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Cell therapy product sales expected to decrease due to competitive headwinds in 2026

risks.title: Évolutions réglementaires impactant les prix des médicaments
risks.score_rationale: Various policy-related developments in the U.S. are expected to offset product sales growth in 2026, with significant impact on pricing and market access Citation: "If, as a result of these inspections, a regulatory authority determines that the equipment, facilities". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: U.S. policy-related developments are expected to negatively impact 2026 revenues

risks.title: Dependence on key products
risks.score_rationale: HIV product sales represent significant revenue concentration (20.8 billion in 2025), creating vulnerability to competitive and regulatory changes Citation: "The administration has issued multiple executive orders and statements that illustrate the intent to require". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: High revenue concentration in HIV products, particularly Biktarvy and Descovy

risks.title: Risques et retards des essais cliniques
risks.score_rationale: Recent clinical trial setbacks include FDA clinical hold on GS-1720/GS-4182 trials and discontinuation of STAR-221 study in gastric cancer Citation: "If any of their processes, methodologies or results were determined to be invalid, inadequate or". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: Clinical trial failures and FDA holds on investigational compounds

risks.title: Litiges de brevets et risque de perte d’exclusivité
risks.score_rationale: Biktarvy patent settlements have extended LOE to April 2036, but continued patent challenges remain in the pipeline Citation: "Presidential administration announced plans to impose up to 100% tariffs on imported branded or patented". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Ongoing patent litigation risks related to key products

risks.title: Foreign exchange volatility
risks.score_rationale: International operations expose Gilead to currency fluctuations affecting reported revenues and financial results Citation: "A manifestation of any of the following risks and uncertainties could, in circumstances we may". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Foreign exchange exposure across 35+ countries of operation

risks.title: Exécution du pipeline et développement de produits
risks.score_rationale: Company targets 10+ transformative therapies by 2030; failure to execute clinical programs and secure approvals threatens long-term growth Citation: "We expend significant time and resources on our product pipeline as well as on preparations". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Success depends on advancing 50+ clinical-stage programs to market

company_description: Gilead Sciences, Inc., a biopharmaceutical company, discovers, develops, and commercializes medicines in the areas of unmet medical need in the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company provides Biktarvy, Descovy, Genvoya, Odefsey, Sunlenca, Symtuza, and YeztugoFor the treatment of HIV-1 infection in patients. It also provides Epclusa, Livdelzi, and Vemlidy to treat chronic hepatitis C virus, primary biliary cholangitis, and chronic hepatitis B virus; Tecartus, a T-cell therapy for the treatment of adult patients; Trodelvy, an injection for intravenous use; and Yescarta, a suspension for intravenous infusion, is a CAR T-cell therapy for the treatment of adult patients. Further, it provides AmBisome, for the treatment of serious invasive fungal infections; and Veklury for the treatment of COVID-19. Additionally, the company engages in the development of various immunotherapies for patients with cancer and other incurable diseases. The company has collaboration agreements with Shenzhen Pregene Biopharma Co., Ltd.; Abingworth; Arcus Biosciences, Inc.; Merck Sharp & Dohme Corp.; Janssen Sciences Ireland Unlimited Company; Japan Tobacco, Inc.; Everest Medicines; Merck & Co
